newsitem.title: UK: UK broadcaster names new managing director.
newsitem.headline: UK broadcaster names new managing director.

text.p: British Interactive Broadcasting, the company led by British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc and British Telecommunications Plc, said on Friday it had named Peter van Gelder as managing director.
BIB said Sam Chisholm, chief executive and managing director at BSkyB, would become BIB's chairman.

BIB, 32.5 percent owned by BSkyB and BT, said it would aim to provide the interactive television platform to enable high-street businesses to offer interactive services including home shopping, banking and travel.
BIB said the services would be available to digital satellite subscribers from summer next year, depending on regulatory approval.
